title: Shared project-side definitions
description: Enumerations shared by the brief, facts, question bank, registry, selection and design schemas. Change these only through a pull request approved by both owners.

projectType.description: The seven project types. Each has one sample brief in samples/briefs.

tier.description: Complexity tier. S: up to 5 pages, no custom interaction. M: up to 12 pages or one advanced approach. L: larger, or several advanced approaches together.

deviceFloor.description: Lowest device class the site must run well on.
